newsitem.title: UK: European high/low sulphur VGO firmer, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: European high/low sulphur VGO firmer, trade thin.

text.p: Low and high sulphur vacuum gas oil prices were firmer with crude and product futures in Europe on Wednesday but trade was thin, traders said.
Several trade houses were heard offering low sulphur product with one U.S. player said offering a cargo out of Spain at what some traders said was an optimistic $152 cif NWE.
Traders said the firmer levels restricted transatlantic arbitrage trade and there was very little buying interest in Europe.
High sulphur barge sellers pegged offers around $136 after trade around this level earlier in the week. Cargo talk was thin.
